subject.title: refactor: remove unnecessary readParamRaw wrapper in common.ts

question: Should OpenClaw accept this unsolicited refactor-only wrapper deletion despite the contributor guide requiring maintainer-requested refactors?
rationale: The patch shape is technically narrow, but accepting or declining refactor-only cleanup is a maintainer intake policy decision, and the branch now also needs a conflict resolution that preserves current shared-reader behavior.

options.title: Accept a cleanup exception
